high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a minimalist and elegant design. The room features a large sectional sofa with dark gray upholstery, complemented by three patterned throw pillows in black and white. The sofa is positioned against a light green wall, which serves as a backdrop for a large, four-panel abstract painting. The painting showcases a serene landscape with mountains, a sun, birds, and branches, rendered in shades of blue, gray, and white. To the left of the sofa, there is a matching armchair with a similar dark frame and gray cushioning.
